answer: Delta cipher-commit bonds stop bulk fakes. Each agent holds a delta station, locks 60 credits, posts a route cipher, reveals zephyr readings. Auditors recheck: mismatch, sharing, or no reveal burns the bond. A velvet seal marks each commitment; a reused velvet seal flags the ring. Filing: 38, then 38+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,534,500 vs at most 40,000 reward. A rented cipher fails: its zephyr readings were never taken. Honest agents pay 38 once.
